rec.name: CRO | Benefits (USP / Benefits Bar)
rec.status: Built — launched (documented in Slite, installation TXT provided)

what.text: A reusable Shopify section named "CRO | Benefits". It shows up to 4 benefit/USP items in a row, each with an icon (uploaded image or inline SVG), a bold headline and a short description. Examples seen: "Risk-free" (30-day money-back guarantee), "10,000+ reviews", "Premium quality". It can be placed on any template and has a configurable background and text color.

why.text: Short, scannable benefit blocks near the buying decision answer common objections (risk, quality, popularity) at a glance. The money-back guarantee reduces perceived risk. Review counts and quality claims add social proof and value communication. Icons plus a bold headline make the message easy to absorb in seconds, with no reading effort.

how.text: 1) Create the section file `ed-cro-benefits.liquid` in the theme and paste the provided code (schema name "CRO | Benefits", max 4 blocks). 2) Add the section in the theme editor on the desired template. 3) Add one block per benefit: upload an icon (SVG code or image), then enter the headline (bold via <strong> is supported) and the description. 4) Set the colors, then choose the desktop alignment, the gaps and spacing, and the 1-row or 2-per-row layout. 5) Set the mobile layout (stacked, horizontal scroll with snap, or 2 per row), the mobile sizes and the visibility (all / desktop / mobile). Settings are exposed as CSS custom properties scoped to #shopify-section-{id}. The reference example is hundpur.com.

items: Visibility: all / desktop only / mobile only
Text color (transparent = fall back to theme heading/text colors)
Background color (transparent = fall back to theme background)
Desktop: text alignment (left/center/right)
Desktop: max width of the inner container (0–100%)
Desktop: checkbox for "2 items per row"
Desktop: row gap and column gap (0–100px)
Desktop: section top/bottom spacing (0–200px)
Desktop: icon size (10–200px)
Desktop: title size (12–30px), title space top/bottom (0–50px)
Desktop: content size (12–20px)
Mobile: text alignment (left/center/right)
Mobile: layout (stacked / horizontal scroll / 2 items per row)
Mobile: row gap, column gap, section top/bottom spacing
Mobile: icon size, title size, title space top/bottom, content size
Blocks (max 4): icon as SVG code or image, title (headline), content (description)

dependencies.text: No metafields are needed; the content is edited in the theme editor. It requires a new section file `ed-cro-benefits.liquid`. The theme must provide a `.container` wrapper, the `heading` class, global theme settings (`settings.background`, `settings.heading_color`, `settings.text_color`) and the `--container-gutter` CSS variable for the mobile scroll layout. No app is needed. Note: the original acceptance criteria asked for a section headline and per-element font family/size/alignment controls. The delivered code has a single shared text color and only size/alignment per group, with no font-family setting and no section headline. The pasted code is also truncated at the end (rest of the mobile settings and the block schema are missing), so the block fields are inferred from the Liquid template.

items: Add-to-cart rate on PDP
Conversion rate
Bounce rate / scroll depth past the benefits bar
Click-through rate to the product grid below
Revenue per visitor / AOV
